scope: Read-only review of mutator handlers, native adapter/core contracts, and host tests; no emulator core or ROM used.

contract_review.confirmation: Only value 0 permits mutation; 1 and 0xFFFF return CANCELLED without Party lookup or native mutation.
contract_review.operand_ids: All variable IDs are range-checked and distinct before GetVarPointer calls; all resolved pointers must be non-null and pairwise distinct before Party lookup/native calls.
contract_review.party_access: SaveArray_Party_Get is called only after confirmation, slot, kind/stat, and saveData validation. The native adapter resolves the selected member and rejects malformed Party counts, empty slots, eggs, and invalid targets.
contract_review.mutation: Set delegates one EV/IV field update and one stat recalculation. Reset clears exactly six values from one family and recalculates once. No direct Pokémon-data access, PID write, or cross-family reset exists in the handlers/core.
contract_review.bounds: Core enforces per-EV 255, total EV 510, and IV 31; invalid stored EV totals and out-of-range values return before writes.

findings.summary: No functional defect found in the reviewed handler logic or delegation to the native adapter/core.
findings.evidence: Static inspection plus passing host suites; cancellation, pointer guards, single-target writes, family isolation, PID preservation, bounds, and one recalculation are covered across handler/core tests.

findings.summary: The existing suite did not exercise Reset-specific invalid variable IDs, null pointers, pointer aliasing, invalid target, empty/egg target, or null saveData paths.
findings.resolution: Added TestResetVariableGuardsAndInvalidTargets to qa/stat_editor_mutators_host_test.c. No handler source was changed.

limitations: The host tests use stubs and do not prove encrypted save-record behavior or live-game side effects.

The conditional STAT_EDITOR_MUTATORS_ARM_ABI_TEST layout assertions are not enabled by the host-test runner; source struct declarations show fieldSystem at ScriptContext offset 0x80 and saveData at FieldSystem offset 0x0C, but no target-ABI compile was run.
Opcodes 854/855 are not registered or linked into a ROM; dispatch, UI confirmation wiring, save/cold behavior, and runtime acceptance remain untested.
